title: Boeing 737 Max 10 certification gets boost as FAA says 'software glitch not a safety issue' | 4 key things to know
summary: Boeing’s 737 Max 10 certification is bolstered by the FAA's finding that a software glitch affecting certain flight computers doesn’t pose a safety risk.&nbsp;

title: Yeast protein gains ground as brands seek alternatives to costly whey
summary: The shift comes as whey protein, a key ingredient in conventional supplements, becomes more expensive. Industry executives said whey protein powder now costs more than  ₹4,500 a kg, up from around  ₹1,000 in 2023.&nbsp;
